items.title: Be alert: targeted attacks on prominent Rustaceans
items.title_zh: Rust 官方警告：维护者与热门 crate 所有者遭社工攻击
items.title_en: Rust warns of social engineering attacks on maintainers and crate owners
items.summary: A security warning details an ongoing campaign targeting Rust maintainers and popular crate owners with social engineering attacks to compromise devices and publish malware.

items.title: I vibed a proof of Conway's conjecture
items.title_zh: Dan Abramov 以「氛围编程」方式尝试证明 Conway 猜想
items.title_en: Dan Abramov 'Vibes' an AI-Assisted Proof of Conway's Conjecture
items.summary: Dan Abramov describes using AI to 'vibe' a proof of Conway's conjecture, prompting extensive expert discussion on LLM-assisted mathematics and proof verification.

items.title: Korea raises data breach fines to 10% of revenue

items.title_en: South Korea raises data breach fines to 10% of revenue
items.summary: Korea raises data breach fines to 10% of revenue, prompting discussion on corporate accountability and enforcement challenges.

items.title: US Military had close call after using AI for hallucinated intelligence report
items.title_zh: 美军险些依据AI幻觉情报采取行动
items.title_en: US Military Narrowly Avoided Action on AI-Hallucinated Intelligence
items.summary: A CNN report describes a close call in which the US military used AI-generated hallucinated intelligence, raising urgent concerns about LLM reliability in high-stakes defense decisions.

items.title: Engrams Embedding Entendre: Codesign for Efficient DRAM/SSD Offloading
items.title_zh: SemiAnalysis：DRAM/SSD 卸载软硬件协同重塑 AI 内存市场格局
items.title_en: SemiAnalysis: DRAM/SSD Offloading Codesign Reshapes AI Memory TAM
items.summary: An analysis of hardware/software codesign for efficient DRAM/SSD offloading and its implications for AI model architectures and memory/storage TAM.

items.title: 🤖 研究员称 xAI Grok CLI 默认上传整个代码库及密钥文件  安全研究人员对 xAI 官方编程命令行工具 Grok Build（版本 0.2.93）进
items.title_zh: 研究员称 xAI Grok Build CLI 默认上传整个代码库及密钥文件
items.title_en: Researchers: xAI Grok Build CLI Uploads Whole Codebases and Secret Files by Default
items.summary: Security researchers allege xAI's Grok Build CLI (v0.2.93) silently uploads the entire code repository—including secret files—to xAI servers and Google Cloud Storage by default.

items.title: Anthropic 悄然设生物实验室推进 AI 药物计划
items.title_zh: Anthropic 悄然设立湿实验室，推进 AI 药物研发计划
items.title_en: Anthropic Sets Up Bay Area Wet Lab for AI Drug Discovery
items.summary: Anthropic has quietly established a wet lab in the San Francisco Bay Area to advance its AI drug discovery program, with Claude potentially directing robotic biology experiments.
